messages:
kenny: quick heads-up — canary run of nova-13b with bitsandbytes int8 weight-only shows a tiny but consistent accuracy delta on the summarization slice (rouge drop ~0.6) :thinking_face:

sasha: on which profile? default batcher config or fastpath?

kenny: default continuous batching + kv-cache enabled. serving profile: batch_size=8, max_tokens=512, kv_cache=true. saw it on 5% of eval cases vs fp16 baseline.

maria: do you have logs / example diffs? small deltas can be prompt-sensitive.

kenny: pasted few diffs below:
```
FP16: "The meeting concluded with consensus on timelines and deliverables."
INT8: "The meeting ended with agreement on tasks and deadlines."
```

kenny: not catastrophic but style and specificity lost a bit. also p95 latency dropped by ~8ms (good) but token-level perplexity up on a couple slices.

jax: interesting — could be quantization interacting with KV cache / continuous batching ordering. did you try disabling continuous batching?

kenny: not yet. sanity-run queued.

infra-bot: deploy canary nova-13b-int8-2026-03-20 queued by kenny — target subset: canary-cust-7 (5%)

eval-bot: eval job 2026-03-20-1523 completed. metrics attached: rouge-l delta -0.61, exact-match -0.3, perplexity +0.9 on longform slice. per-slice breakdown: summarization -0.61, instruction-following -0.05, chit-chat +0.01.

maria: ok that pattern points to content compression/loss of specific tokens. can you capture tokenization / top-k probs for the examples?

kenny: grabbing logits and token ids now. sample snippet -> topk probs for token 'timelines' went from 0.32 to 0.11, model prefers more generic token.

jax: that aligns with lower token precision for rare tokens after int8 weight-only. two quick experiments: 1) try set batch_size=1, continuous_batching=false; 2) try disabling kv_cache for these slices. see if it moves.

kenny: running both. ETA ~15m.

sasha: also try forced fp16 fallback for embeddings-only path? or fallback for top layers (e.g., last 2 layers fp16) if framework supports mixed backend.

kenny: we can try llm.int8 + last layer fp16 hybrid, but need to build a custom quant config. might take longer.

infra-bot: canary scaling event: increased node count +1 to handle batch fluctuation — note added to thread.

eval-bot: quick status: batch_size=1, continuous_batching=false run finished: rouge-l delta -0.12 (much smaller), perplexity +0.2.

maria: nice — points to batching interaction. any latency hit?

kenny: p95 up ~6ms vs int8 default but still below fp16 baseline, so acceptable.

jax: suggests we ship a deploy profile: int8_wonly_preferred with batching=auto but disable continuous batching for generation-heavy summarization routes, and have a fallback that enables fp16 for last-2-layers if user opts-in.

sasha: can we codify this as a rollout policy? i.e., route summarization customers to int8 profile with batching tweaks and hold A/B eval for 7 days before global switch.

maria: yes. I'll open a short RFC and a rollout plan. anyone want to add quick notes for the RFC?

kenny: add recommended config snippet:
```json
{
  "quant": "bnb-int8-w-only",
  "continuous_batching": false,
  "batch_size": 1,
  "kv_cache": true,
  "layer_fallback": "none"
}
```

kenny: also add an optional polyfill for hybrid-last2-fp16 for edge cases.

eval-bot: note: add eval slices for rare-token-heavy summaries + longform chronology; set alert if rouge delta < -0.4 for 3 consecutive pushes.

maria: thanks all. action items: kenny — collate logs + example diffs and add to RFC. jax — prototype hybrid last2 fallback. sasha — draft rollout config + monitoring thresholds. i'll own RFC + PR to console.

kenny: on it. thx :thumbsup:

sasha: tagging @eng-platform to make sure rollout policy UI can express continuous_batching override.

infra-bot: reminder: canary run will auto-expire in 48h unless extended.
